wrong: I am engineer.
right: I am an engineer.
why: Профессия в единственном числе — с a/an, перед гласным звуком an.

wrong: He is the good specialist in strength analysis.
right: He is a good specialist in strength analysis.
ru: Он хороший специалист по расчётам на прочность.
why: Характеристика «какой-то хороший специалист» — a, а не the.

wrong: Sun is a star.
right: The Sun is a star.
why: Единственные в своём роде объекты — с the: the Sun, the Moon.

wrong: The life is hard sometimes.
right: Life is hard sometimes.
why: Абстрактное понятие в общем смысле — без артикля.

wrong: It's best solution for this bracket.
right: It's the best solution for this bracket.
ru: Это лучшее решение для этого кронштейна.
why: Превосходная степень — всегда с the.

wrong: I go to work by the car.
right: I go to work by car.
ru: Я езжу на работу на машине.
why: By + транспорт — без артикля.

wrong: She found a job in the Moscow.
right: She found a job in Moscow.
why: Названия городов — без артикля.

wrong: The test takes a hour.
right: The test takes an hour.
why: В hour h не читается, первый звук гласный — нужно an.

wrong: This is a only option we have.
right: This is the only option we have.
ru: Это единственный вариант, который у нас есть.
why: The only — «единственный»: предмет определён, нужен the.

wrong: It depends from the weather.
right: It depends on the weather.
why: Depend on — только on, хотя по-русски «от».

wrong: Let's discuss about the plan.
right: Let's discuss the plan.
why: Discuss — без предлога about.

wrong: I'm interested on space technology.
right: I'm interested in space technology.
why: Interested in — только in.

wrong: We are waiting the answer from the customer.
right: We are waiting for the answer from the customer.
why: Wait for something — for обязателен.

wrong: See you in Monday.
right: See you on Monday.
why: Дни недели — on.

wrong: The meeting is at the morning.
right: The meeting is in the morning.
why: Части суток — in the morning / in the evening.

wrong: The kit consists from five parts.
right: The kit consists of five parts.
why: Consist of — только of.

wrong: Please send the drawings until Friday.
right: Please send the drawings by Friday.
why: Срок «не позже» — by. Until — «до тех пор» для длительного действия.

wrong: We arrived to Kazan at six.
right: We arrived in Kazan at six.
ru: Мы прибыли в Казань в шесть.
why: Arrive in + город, arrive at + место. Arrive to не бывает.

wrong: Call me on five o'clock.
right: Call me at five o'clock.
why: Точное время — at.

wrong: I'm interested on machine tools.
right: I'm interested in machine tools.
why: Interested in — только in.

wrong: I have sent the email yesterday.
right: I sent the email yesterday.
why: С yesterday — только Past Simple.

wrong: I work here since 2022.
right: I have worked here since 2022.
why: Since + момент до сих пор — Present Perfect.

wrong: I know him for ten years.
right: I have known him for ten years.
why: Состояние длится до сих пор (for ten years) — Present Perfect.

wrong: Listen! Someone sings in the next room.
right: Listen! Someone is singing in the next room.
ru: Послушай! Кто-то поёт в соседней комнате.
why: Происходит прямо сейчас — Present Continuous.

wrong: If it will rain, we will stay at home.
right: If it rains, we will stay at home.
ru: Если пойдёт дождь, мы останемся дома.
why: После if (условие) будущее время не ставится — Present Simple.

wrong: When I will finish, I'll call you.
right: When I finish, I'll call you.
ru: Когда я закончу, я тебе позвоню.
why: После when о будущем — Present Simple.

wrong: I am working here for two years.
right: I have been working here for two years.
why: Длится с прошлого до сейчас + for — Present Perfect Continuous.

wrong: I am knowing the answer.
right: I know the answer.
why: Know — глагол состояния, в Continuous не используется.

wrong: I have seen him last week.
right: I saw him last week.
ru: Я видел его на прошлой неделе.
why: Last week — законченное время, Past Simple.

wrong: Where you work?
right: Where do you work?
why: В вопросе с обычным глаголом нужен do/does.

wrong: What time the meeting starts?
right: What time does the meeting start?
why: Нужен does, а глагол — без -s: does … start.

wrong: Could you tell me where is the lab?
right: Could you tell me where the lab is?
why: Косвенный вопрос — прямой порядок слов, без инверсии.

wrong: Do you know what time is it?
right: Do you know what time it is?
why: После Do you know… — прямой порядок: what time it is.

wrong: Why you didn't call me?
right: Why didn't you call me?
why: В прямом вопросе вспомогательный глагол — перед подлежащим: didn't you.

wrong: Does she works here?
right: Does she work here?
why: После does глагол без -s: окончание уже «ушло» в does.

wrong: How much it costs?
right: How much does it cost?
why: Прямой вопрос с обычным глаголом — с does и без -s.

wrong: I don't know where does he live.
right: I don't know where he lives.
ru: Я не знаю, где он живёт.
why: Косвенный вопрос — без does и с прямым порядком: where he lives.

wrong: Did you saw the results?
right: Did you see the results?
why: После did — начальная форма глагола (see), а не прошедшая (saw).

wrong: Thank you for the informations.
right: Thank you for the information.
why: Information неисчисляемое, без -s.

wrong: We bought new equipments for the lab.
right: We bought new equipment for the lab.
ru: Мы купили новое оборудование для лаборатории.
why: Equipment неисчисляемое, без -s.

wrong: Can you give me an advice?
right: Can you give me some advice?
why: Advice неисчисляемое: some advice или a piece of advice, но не an advice.

wrong: Thank you for your feedbacks.
right: Thank you for your feedback.
why: Feedback неисчисляемое, без -s.

wrong: He did many researches on this topic.
right: He did a lot of research on this topic.
why: Research неисчисляемое: a lot of research, а не many researches.

wrong: How much samples do you need?
right: How many samples do you need?
why: Samples исчисляемое — how many.

wrong: The news are good.
right: The news is good.
why: News неисчисляемое, глагол в единственном числе.

wrong: We need to install new softwares.
right: We need to install new software.
why: Software неисчисляемое, без -s.

wrong: I don't have many time today.
right: I don't have much time today.
why: Time неисчисляемое — much.

wrong: I am agree with you.
right: I agree with you.
why: Agree — глагол, am перед ним не нужен.

wrong: Can you explain me this formula?
right: Can you explain this formula to me?
why: Explain something to someone. «Explain me» — калька.

wrong: He said me the truth.
right: He told me the truth.
why: Tell someone the truth. После say человек без to не ставится.

wrong: I made my homework.
right: I did my homework.
why: Do homework — с do.

wrong: We need to do a decision.
right: We need to make a decision.
why: Make a decision — с make.

wrong: I look forward to hear from you.
right: I look forward to hearing from you.
why: В look forward to слово to — предлог, после него -ing.

wrong: I suggest to repeat the test.
right: I suggest repeating the test.
why: Suggest + -ing (или that…), не suggest to.

wrong: I am boring at this lecture.
right: I am bored at this lecture.
why: Чувство человека — bored. I am boring = «я скучный».

wrong: My parents didn't let me to go.
right: My parents didn't let me go.
why: Let + кого + глагол без to.

wrong: The samples was tested yesterday.
right: The samples were tested yesterday.
why: Samples — множественное число: were tested.

wrong: The bridge was build in 1990.
right: The bridge was built in 1990.
why: В пассиве — третья форма: built.

wrong: This engine designed by Korolev's team.
right: This engine was designed by Korolev's team.
why: Без was в предложении нет сказуемого — выходит только словосочетание «этот двигатель, спроектированный командой Королёва». Пассив: be + третья форма (was designed).

wrong: The part is made by steel.
right: The part is made of steel.
why: Материал — made of. By — для того, кто сделал.

wrong: The report will written tomorrow.
right: The report will be written tomorrow.
why: Будущий пассив: will be + третья форма.

wrong: The results are show in Figure 3.
right: The results are shown in Figure 3.
why: После are в пассиве — третья форма: shown.

wrong: The test rig is building now.
right: The test rig is being built now.
why: Стенд сам не строит — процесс в пассиве: is being built.

wrong: The bolts must tightened carefully.
right: The bolts must be tightened carefully.
why: Пассив с модальным глаголом: must be + третья форма.

wrong: I born in Saratov.
right: I was born in Saratov.
why: Be born — всегда с was/were.

wrong: This lathe designed by our chief engineer.
right: This lathe was designed by our chief engineer.
ru: Этот станок спроектировал наш главный инженер.
why: Без was в предложении нет сказуемого — выходит только словосочетание «этот станок, спроектированный нашим главным инженером». Пассив: be + третья форма (was designed).

wrong: I go always to work by metro.
right: I always go to work by metro.
ru: Я всегда езжу на работу на метро.
why: Always — перед обычным глаголом.

wrong: He is enough old to drive.
right: He is old enough to drive.
why: Enough — после прилагательного.

wrong: I am too a student.
right: I am also a student.
why: Also ставится после be: I am also a student. Too — только в конце предложения: I am a student too.

wrong: She speaks very well English.
right: She speaks English very well.
why: Глагол и дополнение не разрываем, наречие — в конце.

wrong: I like very much this job.
right: I like this job very much.
why: Very much — в конце, после дополнения.

wrong: Never I have seen such a big rocket.
right: I have never seen such a big rocket.
ru: Я никогда не видел такую большую ракету.
why: Never — между have и третьей формой.

wrong: She drinks usually coffee in the morning.
right: She usually drinks coffee in the morning.
why: Usually — перед обычным глаголом.

wrong: We bought a wooden big table.
right: We bought a big wooden table.
why: Размер — раньше материала: big wooden.

wrong: I checked carefully the drawing.
right: I checked the drawing carefully.
why: Наречие не ставят между глаголом и дополнением.

wrong: Never I have seen such a big press.
right: I have never seen such a big press.
ru: Я никогда не видел такой большой пресс.
why: Never стоит между have и третьей формой: I have never seen. Never в начале возможно только с инверсией (Never have I seen…), но это книжный, эмоциональный стиль.
